description: Run OpenProof's website scan on one public web address and return the DPDP-related signals found: consent banner and cookies before consent, third-party trackers, privacy-policy presence and content signals, signup-form consent checkbox, sensitive-field collection and TLS. It reads only the public page, honours site-owner opt-outs, and is an automated surface check, not an audit or legal advice. Limited to a few scans per hour per client. Send it as its own request, not inside a batch.
name: scan_site
